articles.summary: After a highly competitive review process, AesculaTech’s Humidifeye has received SBIR funding from National Eye Institute (NEI) at the U.S. National Institutes of Health (NIH). The total value of the fast-track SBIR award is over $1.5 million meant for research, development, and testing. For those not familiar with the SBIR process, fast track awards include […]
articles.title: HUMIDIFEYE PROJECT AWARDED $1.5M NIH FAST TRACK SBIR, PHASE I STARTS NOW!
